page.overview:
Who is Beorgor Zucker?

Beorgor Zucker is the highest ranking official of the Reik and Talabec Trading Company in Altdorf. A man of the people, he is a Docklands native and claims to have started at the Reik and Talabec as a lowly dockhand. He is now a successful businessman and says he moves more goods than anybody else in Altdorf, and pays less duty on them too.

Although he's no gangster, he likes to imply that he has a close connection to the local criminal gang known as the Fish. He can present himself as a respectable businessman or as a dockland bruiser, depending on who he's trying to impress and how.
